arguments.old_string: Custom ``key_func`` could be used same way as in :func:`@memoize<memoize>`::
arguments.new_string:
The decorated function exposes its internal dictionary as ``.memory``, whose
    values are ``(result, timestamp)`` pairs. It also exposes ``.skip`` as
    :class:`SkipMemoization`: raising it returns its first argument (or ``None``)
    without caching the result, just like :func:`@memoize<memoize>`.

    Custom ``key_func`` could be used same way as in :func:`@memoize<memoize>`::

@reraise(requests.RequestsError, MyAPIError)
        def api_call(...):
            # ...

    ``into`` can be an exception class, an exception instance, or a callable
    receiving the caught exception and returning the exception to raise::

        with reraise(ValueError, lambda error: MyAPIError(str(error))):
            # ...
